actor: benchmark user comparing models or arms
result: two runs answer the same questions, or the user is told they will not
acceptance: a multi-run benchmark reuses the first run's questions for every later run
--questions-from hands the earlier run's questions to the answer step and generates none
two runs on one --questions-root answer exactly its golden set and generate none
preflight rejects a missing key, a missing or malformed --questions-from, and a --questions-root without a readable golden set, before any API call
negative_behavior: a run with no question source warns that questions are generated and names --questions-root; a --questions-from run does not
